chunks: ʿĪṣ ibn al-Qāsim asked Abā ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام:
about one who does not fast the three days of every month while fasting is difficult for him: is there any fidyah in it?
So he said: “A mudd of food for each day.”

key_terms.الثَّلَاثَةَ: the three days customarily observed each month
key_terms.فِدَاءٌ: compensatory substitute or expiation in this context
key_terms.مُدٌّ: a mudd, a known measure of food

ai.seo_question: What is the compensation for someone who cannot fast the three recommended days of every month?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning one who is unable to maintain the recommended fast of three days each month because fasting is too difficult. The Imam عليه السلام states that a mudd of food is to be given for each missed day as compensation.
